claims.finding: Model.predict sets rect=True by default, overriding default.yaml rect=False. Single-image same_shapes=True plus rect=True makes .pt LetterBox auto use stride-aligned rectangle rather than necessarily square640.

NumPy route LetterBoxes, converts BGR to RGB and normalizes after dtype conversion; Tensor route does not LetterBox, channel-flip or normalize again. Do not treat manually LetterBoxed Tensor Results orig_shape as the original source image.

Gain is min(newH/H,newW/W); resized dimensions round each axis. Centered remainder uses round(d-0.1),round(d+0.1), so odd padding is asymmetric. auto=True reduces remainder modulo stride. Record actual integer left/top padding and nominal gain.
Apply image with cv2.resize then cv2.copyMakeBorder constant114; default interpolation is cv2.INTER_LINEAR, center=True and scaleup=True.

Predictor deepcopy model then AutoBackend(fp16=args.quantize==16, fuse=True). Legacy half/int8 aliases are mapped to quantize by cfg.__init__.py:594-603. Fixed manual raw dtype bypasses these defaults deliberately.
load_checkpoint chooses EMA before model, casts candidate to FP32, defaults fuse=False, then eval().to(device); compatibility updates include inplace=True by default.

save_model serializes a deepcopy of EMA cast to half, with framework finite-resync/clamp behavior. The training runner guard is a separate protection. Casting saved EMA to float does not restore original training FP32 EMA values.
strip_optimizer replaces model with EMA, casts model half, clears EMA and epoch=-1. Use final receipt/results to identify selected epoch; final checkpoint epoch alone is insufficient.

Non-end2end eval returns (decoded_y, raw_heads) unless export. Decoded y concatenates pixel-space xywh and sigmoid class scores along channel axis, hence nc10 gives Bx14xN without an objectness channel. Expected square640 strides8/16/32 gives N8400; runtime must verify, not assume.
Backend loads checkpoint then optionally fuses Conv+BN and finally converts dtype; predictor requests fuse=True. Raw unfused and default predictor fused are different arithmetic paths.
NMS transposes prediction as a view and overwrites first four channels converting xywh to xyxy. Clone input after saving/comparing raw output.

Best-class-only by default, strict confidence greater-than cutoff, class offsets, max_nms cap, then torchvision or TorchNMS chosen from already imported sys.modules. max_det caps output; time limit can interrupt batches. Pin CPU FP32 and explicit torchvision import for qualification.

scale_boxes reverses gain/pad but default xyxy path clips to image. Project ignore raster must see raw original-coordinate boxes first, so use explicit unclipped inverse transform before matcher; keep optional clipped copy separately.

Framework raises default max_det300 to observed dataset maximum902; this is not manual tuning. Parent verified train max351 and training_val max902. Qualification uses its separately fixed max_det1000.
YOLO loader uses np.unique on label rows and drops duplicates in cache. Parent verified three dropped positives, one in each specified train image; original prepared label bytes remain untouched.

evaluator_adapter.ground_truth: Read original eight-column annotation for each permitted debug image, retaining category0/11, score0, truncation and occlusion. Do not reconstruct GT from YOLO labels.
evaluator_adapter.target_id: image_id + ':' + original physical zero-based line index, blank lines counted; parser strips optional BOM but preserves physical indexing.
evaluator_adapter.prediction: Restored unclipped xyxy -> [x1,y1,x2-x1,y2-y1]; best YOLO class0..9 mapped explicitly to publisher category1..10; score is decoded class probability. Unique detection_id includes image_id, dtype and post-NMS row index.
evaluator_adapter.ignore_order: category0 pixel-raster prefilter on raw original boxes, then project clips surviving boxes, performs positive IoU-first matching, then same-class score0 absorption. Category11 is not a universal ignore region.
evaluator_adapter.identity_dedup: Do not deduplicate original GT; each physical annotation row remains a distinct identity even if YOLO training cache deduplicated exact label rows.
